title: Too lightweight!
text: Too lightweight!. I’d had a few sets of metal nesting bowls over the years. These are by far the lightest, thinnest ones I’ve ever used. They also spot really really bad. I’m sure they will dent and warp quickly. They nest inside one another really nicely and it’s kind of cool to have sooooo many bowls. I mostly use the 3 largest though so the smaller ones are a bit redundant imo

product_metadata.title: Casa Haus Mixing Bowls (Set of 6) Premium Stainless Steel - Easy to Clean, Nesting Bowls for Space Saving Storage, Great for Cooking

QUALITY STAINLESS STEEL - features an attractive mirror finish, for an elegant look enhancing your kitchen tools, these metal bowl set are easy to clean, as well as odor, stain and taste resistant.

description: Bored of using the regular mixing bowl at home.Premium Steel ones gives durability but lacks designs and attractiveness. We present to you our unique range of mixing bowls with Blue colour and silver linning. The mixing bowl is heavy enough to counter the tendency to slide around during manual mixing or kneading/ yet light enough to allow you to hold the bowl in one arm easily while the other can be used for beating the mixture. The wide/ shallow shape of the bowl is just right for kneading dough. It comes with set of 6 pcs.
